dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature following a smooth falcate spline from the dorsal ridge junction to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1.2 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex melon boundary with a consistent, wide-radius arc transition into the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated and slender rostrum with a high length-to-thickness ratio, extending linearly from the cranial inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon curvature transitions to the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Luminescent/translucent body texture with a long, thin, monochromatic linear projection extending from the posterior peduncle/fluke region.
